parameters.seed_policy: Use committed seeds or the custodian seed; never reselect after output.

measurement_procedure: In disposable exact-SHA clones, retain environment and raw stdout/stderr for isolated environment/cleanliness preflight and postflight checks, locked sync, lint, TeX source validation, full tests, six examples, semantic artifact validation, two pdflatex passes, and seven frozen mutations.
uncertainty_procedure: Command exits, test counts, structure, mutation rejection, PYTHONPATH absence, and complete tracked/untracked Git cleanliness are exact. Numeric drift uses only the committed semantic-checker tolerances.
statistical_analysis: Pass only if both platforms succeed at the exact candidate, PYTHONPATH is unset, isolated preflight and postflight report no tracked or untracked residue, Windows builds a nonempty PDF, regeneration is contract-equivalent, all corruptions are rejected, and no required result exists only in an agent summary. Missing commands, surviving mutations, any repository residue, undeclared import state, or a platform-only result are failures.
commands: python -I -c "import os,subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr); blocked=bool(os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH')); sys.stderr.write('PYTHONPATH must be unset\n' if blocked else ''); raise SystemExit(p.returncode or bool(p.stdout) or blocked)"

uv run python -I -c "import os,subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr); blocked=bool(os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH')); sys.stderr.write('PYTHONPATH must be unset\n' if blocked else ''); raise SystemExit(p.returncode or bool(p.stdout) or blocked)"
mutation_plan: Add an unregistered noninformational check identity; require rejection.
Flip a required check pass outcome; require rejection.
Change a measurement array shape; require rejection.
Change a stable configuration beyond tolerance; require rejection.
Make a required visual empty and untracked; require both defects.
Move a sensitive scientific diagnostic beyond its frozen threshold; require rejection.
Activate an untracked sitecustomize.py through PYTHONPATH; require isolated preflight or postflight rejection.
